question: As per Article _______ of the Constitution of India, English is the official language for all the high courts in the country.
solution:
The correct answer is __**348 (1)**__.

__
 
• **As per Article 348 (1) of the Constitution of India, English is the official language for all the high courts in the country**__. 
 
• Article 348(1) stipulates the use of English in the Supreme Court and High Courts as well as for drafting Bills, Acts and Orders.
 __
 
• Article 348(2) read with Section (7) of the Official Languages Act 1963 provides for Hindi or other official languages to be used in High Courts “in addition to English”.
